section.haptics-general.title: Vibration
haptics.enabled.label: Enable Haptic Feedback
haptics.enabled.description: Enable controller vibration/rumble for game events. Requires a compatible controller (Xbox, Switch Pro, DualSense).
haptics.intensity.label: Vibration Intensity
haptics.intensity.description: Global intensity multiplier for all haptic feedback
section.haptics-combat.title: Combat
haptics.sword-swing.label: Sword Swing
haptics.sword-swing.description: Very faint vibration when the player swings the sword
haptics.sword-hit-enemy.label: Sword Hit Enemy
haptics.sword-hit-enemy.description: Normal vibration when the sword connects with an enemy
haptics.sword-clink.label: Sword Clink
haptics.sword-clink.description: Faint vibration when the sword clinks against an invulnerable surface or shield
haptics.damage-taken.label: Damage Taken
haptics.damage-taken.description: Vibration scaled to damage amount when the player gets hurt (stronger for more damage)
section.haptics-actions.title: Items and Movement
haptics.item-use.label: Item Use
haptics.item-use.description: Vibration when using items (hammer, hookshot, bombs, medallions, rods, etc.)
haptics.dash-vibration.label: Dash Vibration
haptics.dash-vibration.description: Rhythmic step vibration while running with the Pegasus Boots
haptics.environmental-effects.label: Environmental Effects
haptics.environmental-effects.descriptio: Vibration for world events: falling into pits, landing from ledges, entering water, mirror warp, chest opens, bomb explosions
